# Noto Emoji sprite provenance

`components/avatar/emoji_sprites.cpp` was imported from
[`nuwaa/AtomS3R-Acoustic-Modem`](https://github.com/nuwaa/AtomS3R-Acoustic-Modem),
commit `8904fb23e0da1a6d64210a16e1d79f6d9fb89d9e`, and repacked from 32 to 16
colours per sprite for Stack-chan's fixed firmware partition.

The images derive from Google Noto Emoji revision
`e20cbc2bbec1926686be9f9bee7d1d2cfa1fea0e` (Unicode 18.0 release,
2026-09-24) under Apache License 2.0. Sequence keys derive from Unicode
`emoji-test.txt`, Version 18.0, dated 2026-04-30. See the
[Unicode Terms of Use](https://www.unicode.org/terms_of_use.html).
